s: klI, (buD + Ric + lyuw .) ganDadIpanam । iti medinI । ne, 99 ॥ vedanam । vijYApanam । iti buDaDAtvarTadarSanAt ॥ (uddIpanam । yaTA mAGe । 9 । 34 । “samayena tena cirasuptamanoBavaboDanaM samaboDizata ॥” “manoBavasya kAmasya boDanaM uddIpanaM yasmin .” iti tawwikAyAM mallinATaH । jYAnam । yaTA, raGO । 9 । 49 । “paricayaM calalakzyanipAtane BayaruzoSca tadiNgitavoDanam ॥” “tezAM calalakzyARAM iNgitasya cezwitasya BayAdiliNgaBUtasya boDanaM jYAnaM ca karoti .” iti tawwIkAyAM mallinATaH ॥) durgAyA boDanaM yaTA । devIpurARe । “ize mAsyasite pakze kanyArASigate ravO । navamyAM boDayeddevIM krIqAkOtukamaNgalEH ॥” atra kfzRAditvAdize ityapi gORASvinaparam । ataeva kAlakOmudyAdiDftam । yaTA, -- “karkiRyarke harO supte SakraDvajakriyASvine । tulAyAM boDayeddevIM vfScike tu janArddanam ॥” iti ॥ boDayediti SezaH । tatrApi navamIboDanaM kanyAyAmeva taTEva samBavAt tena siMhArke tulArke'pyASvinatvena vAkyaracanAM । evaM prativarzaM karttavyatvAdArdrAdinakzatrAlABe'pi boDanAdikAryyam । nakzatrayogastu PalAtiSayAya । taTA ca liNgapurARam । “mUlABAve'pi saptamyAM kevalAyAM praveSayet । taTA tiTyantarezvevamfkzezu ca PaloccayaH ॥” yaTAha devalaH । “tiTinakzatrayoryoge dvayorevAnupAlanam । yogABAve tiTirgrAhyA devyAH pUjanakarmmaRi ॥” kfzRanavamyAmArdrAyogo viDO mantre ca SrUyate । taTA ca liNgapurARam । “kanyAyAM kfzRapakze tu pUjayitvArdraBe divA । navamyAM boDayeddevIM mahAviBavavistarEH ॥” caturTapAde gItavAditraniH svanEriti kAlikApurARe pAWaH । “ize mAsyasite pakze navamyAmArdrayogataH । SrIvfkze boDayAmi tvAM yAvat pUjAM karomyaham ॥ EM rAvaRasya vaDArTAya rAmasyAnugrahAya ca । akAle brahmaRA boDo devyAstvayi kftaH purA ॥” iti mantraliNgam ॥ akAla iti tu rAtritvena dakziRAyanasya । taTAca SrutiH । tapastapasyO SESirAvftuH maDuSca mADavaSca vAsantikAvftuH SukraSca SuciSca grEpmAvftuH । aTEtaduttarAyaRaM devAnAM dinaM naBASca naBasyaSca vArzikAvftuH izaSca UrjaSca SAradAvftuH sahASca sahasyaSca hEmantikAvftuH । aTEtaddakziRAyanaM devAnAM rAtririti । evaYca । rAtrAveva mahAmAyA brahmaRA boDitA purA । taTEva ca narAH kuryyuH pratisambatsaraM nfpetyetadbizayam ॥ ataeva liNgapurARakAlikApurARayorddivetyuktam । evaYca kAlikApurARe boDane rAtrAvitipadaM devatArAtriparam । tataSca pUrvvAhRe navamyAmArdrAyuktAyAM boDanaM pUrvvAhRetarakAla eva ArdrAlABe divetyatra divApadAttatrApi boDanaM anyaTA divApadaM vyarTaM syAt । jyotizArRave vyaktamuktaM varAheRa । “kanyAdimInaparyyantaM yatra saMprApyate SivaH । tatra boDaH prakarttavyo devyA rAjYAM SuBapradaH ॥” Siva ArdrA । evaYcoBayadine pUrvvAhRe navamIlABe paratrArdrAlABe paratra boDanaM na tu yugmAt pUrvvatra । yugmabADakapUrvvAhRasya bADakanakzatrAnuroDAt divA nakzatrAlABe tu pUrvvAhRa eva navamyAM uBayatra pUrvvAhRalABe pUrvvadina eva yugmAt । atra kevalanavamyAM boDanaviDernakzatrasyApi guRaPalatvAcca । “mAGe'Ta PAlgune vApi BavedvE mAGasaptamI । mAkarIti ca yatproktaM tatprAyovfttidarSanAt ॥” iti ॥ sOrAgamAt mAkaryyAdivat ArdrAyoga ityasya prAyikatvenABiDAnaM pratIyate । tataScArdrArahitaboDane mantrAntarAnupadeSAt tanmantraH praRavayuktatvena prayujyate । “yannayUnaYcAtiriktaYca yacCidraM yadayajYiyam । yadameDyamaSudDaYca yAtayAmaYca yadBavet । tadoNkAraprayuktena sarvvaYcAviPalaM Bavet ॥” iti yogiyAjYavalkyAt zazWyAM boDane'pyevam ॥ navamIboDanAsAmarTye tu zazWyAM sAyaM boDanam । taTA Bavizye । “zazWyAM vilvatarO bADaM sAyaMsanDyAsu kArayet ॥” sanDyoktA varAheRa । “ardDAstamayAt sanDyA vyaktIBUtA na tArakA yAvat ॥” zazWyAM boDane tu prAgukta EM rAvaRasya vaDArTAyeti ahamapyASvine zazWyAM sAyAhne boDayAmyata iti paWet । yadA tu pUrvvadine sAyaM zazWIlABaH paradine sAyaM vinA zazWIlABaH tadA pUrvvedyurboDanaM paradine sAyamAmantraRam । yadA tUBayadine sAyaM zazWyalABastadA pare'hani pUrvvAhRe zazWyAM boDanam । “boDayedvilvaSAKAyAM zazWyAM devIM Palezu ca । zazWyAM boDane tu na kzatrAnupadeSAnna tadAdaraH ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥

Bavizye “zazWyAM bilvatarO boDaM sAyaM sanDyAsu kArayet” । sanDyoktA varAhamihireRa “ardDAstamayAt sanDyA vyaktIBUtA na tArakA yAvat” । zazWyAM boDane tu prAguktaH “oM rAvaRasya bavArTAya” iti । ityAdI prAguktadevIpurARe navamIzazWyorboDanAmantraRayoH pfTaktvABiDAnAcca । tataSca zazWyAmuBayakaraRe'pi patrIpraveSapUrvadine sAyaMzazWIlABe ekadEvoBayakaraRam । yadA tu pUrvadine sAyaMzazWIlABaH बोधयितृ m. (fr. Caus.) an awakener, RV. i, 161, 13
a teacher, preceptor, MW.
a: बोधयितृ — m. 1 A teacher, preceptor. --2 A waker.

m: बोधयिष्णु mfn. (fr. Caus.) wishing to awaken or to arouse, R.
बोधेन्द्र m. N. of an author, Cat.
बोधेय m. pl. N. of a Vedic school (cf. अद्धा-ब्˚ and बौधेय).

s: puM, (buDa + “sarvvaDAtuBya in .” 4 । 117 । iti in .) samADiBedaH । pippalavfkzaH । iti medinI । De, 11 ॥ (yaTAsya paryyAyaH । “pippalo boDiraSvatTaScEtyavfkzo gajASanaH ॥” iti vEdyakaratnamAlAyAm ॥) boDaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ jYAtari, tri । ityuRAdikozaH ॥
v: pu॰ buDa--in । 1 samADiBede 2 pippalavfkze 3 budDaBede medi॰ 4 boDe trikA॰ । 5 jYAtari tri॰ ।
m: बोधि m. f. (with Buddhists or Jainas) perfect knowledge or wisdom (by which a man becomes a Buddha or Jina), the illuminated or enlightened intellect (of a B˚ or J˚), Kathās.; Rājat.; Śatr.; Lalit. (cf. MWB. 97, 188 &c.)
बोधि m. the tree of wisdom under which perfect w˚ is attained or under which a man becomes a Buddha, the sacred fig-tree, (Ficus Religiosa), Hcat. (MWB. 35, 181 &c.)
‘wakener’, a cock, L.
N. of a man (= Buddha in a former birth), Jātakam.
of a mythical elephant, Lalit.
of a place, L.
pl. N. of a people, R.
बोधि mfn. learned, wise, Uṇ. iv, 117.
a: बोधिः — [बुध्-इन्] 1 Perfect wisdom or enlightenment. --2 The enlightened intellect of a Buddha. --3 The sacred fig-tree. --4 A cock. --5 An epithet of Buddha. --Comp. --तरुः, द्रुमः, -वृक्षः the sacred fig-tree. --दः an arhat (of the Jainas). --सत्त्वः a Buddhist saint, one who is on the way to the attainment of perfect knowledge and has only a certain number of births to undergo before attaining to the state of a Supreme Buddha and complete annihilation (this position could be attained by a long series of pious and virtuous deeds); एवंविधैर्विलसितैरतिबोधिसत्त्वैः Māl. 10. 21.

m: बोधि—भद्र m. N. of a teacher, Buddh.
बोधि—धर्म m. N. of a Buddhist patriarch (whose original name was Bodhi-dhana), L.
बोधि—चित्त-विवरण n. N. of wk.
बोधि—चित्तोत्पादन-शास्त्र n. N. of wk.
बोधि—द m. (with Jainas) an Arhat, L.
बोधि—द्रुम m. = -तरु, L.

k.v: विदार्याद्यास्तु मूलेऽपि पुष्पे क्लीबेऽपि पाटला। बोधिद्रुमश्चलदलः पिप्पलः कुञ्जराशनः॥

m: बोधिल m. (fr. बोधि) N. of a teacher, Buddh.
बोधि—मण्ड m. or n. (?) seat of wisdom (N. of the seats which were said to have risen out of the earth under 4 successive trees where Gautama Buddha attained to perfect wisdom), MWB. 232 (cf. next).
बोधि—मण्डल n. N. of the place where Gautama Buddha attained to perfect wisdom, Lalit.
बोधिन् mfn. (ifc.) intent upon, careful of MārkP.
knowing, familiar with, Cat.
causing to know or perceive, Sāh.
awakening, enlightening (cf. ज्ञान-, तत्त्व-, बाल-बोधिनी).
a: बोधिन् — a. [बुध्-णिनि] 1 Knowing, familiar with. --2 Acquainting, informing, making known. --3 Teaching, explaining. --4 Arousing, awakening.

m: बोधिन्-मनस् mfn. (according to Padap. fr. बोधित्-म्˚) one whose mind is awake, watchful, attentive, RV.
बोधि—न्यास m. N. of wk.
बोधि—पक्ष-धर्म m. a quality belonging to (or a constituent of) perfect intelligence, Lalit.
बोधि—पक्ष-धर्म—निर्देश m. N. of wk.
बोधि—पक्षिक mfn. belonging to perfect intelligence (with धर्म, m. = पक्ष-ध्˚, Dharmas. 43).
बोधि-परिनिष्पत्ति f. perfect knowledge, Sukh. i.
बोधि—रुचि m. N. of a scholar, Buddh.
बोधि—संघाराम m. N. of a monastery, Buddh.
बोधि—सत्˚त्वांश m. part of a B˚
बोधि—सत्˚त्वावदान-कल्प-लता f. N. of wk.

s: klI, (boDi boDavat sattvam .) budDaviSezaH । iti hemacandraH । 2 । 146 ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 22 । 35 । “dayAlurboDisattvAMSaH ko'nyo jImUtavAhanAt । SaknuyAdarTisAt karttumapi kalpadrumaM kftI ॥”)
v: na॰ boDi boDayutaM sattvam । budDaBede hemaca॰ ।
m: बोधि—सत्त्व m. ‘one whose essence is perfect knowledge’, one who is on the way to the attainment of p˚ k˚ (i.e. a Buddhist saint when he has only one birth to undergo before obtaining the state of a supreme Buddha and then Nirvāṇa), Śiś.; Kathās.; Rājat.; Buddh. (the early doctrine had only one Bodhisattva, viz. Maitreya; the later reckoned many more, MWB. 134, 188, 189)
N. of the principal Buddha of the present era (before he became a Buddha), Śiś., Sch.; L.
of a poet, Cat.
बोधि—सत्त्व—भूमि f. N. of wk.
बोधि—सत्त्व—बुद्धानुस्मृति-समाधि m. N. of wk.
बोधि—सत्त्व—चर्या f. the actions or condition of a Bodhisattva, Lalit.
बोधि—सत्त्व—चर्यावतार m. N. of wk.
बोधि—सत्त्व—पक्ष-निर्देश m. N. of wk.
बोधि—सत्त्व—पिटक m. n. N. of wk.
बोधि-सत्त्व-संचोदिणी f. N. of a partic. ray of light, Lalit.
बोधि-सत्त्व-समुच्चया f. N. of a Buddh. deity
बोधि—सत्त्व—ता f. the state of a B˚-state, Bodhisattva-ship, Kathās.
बोधि—सिद्धि f. N. of wk.

s: tri, (buD + Ric + kta .) jYApitam । yaTA, -- “rAtrAveva mahAmAyA brahmaRA boDitA purA ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
m: बोधित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made known, apprised, explained
informed, instructed
admonished, reminded, MBh.; R.
a: बोधित — p. p. [बुध्-णिच् क्त] 1 Made known, informed, apprised. --2 Reminded. --3 Advised, instructed.

s: puM, (boDireva taruH .) aSvatTavfkzaH । iti hemacandraH । 4 । 197 ॥ (guRAdayo'syASvatTaSabde drazwavyAH ॥)
v: pu॰ karma॰ । aSvatTavfkze hemaca॰ । boDidrumAdayo'pyatra pu॰
m: बोधि—तरु m. ‘tree of wisdom’, Ficus Religiosa, L. (cf. above).
बोधितव्य mfn. to be made known, to be imparted or communicated, L. (cf. बोधयितव्य).

s: tri, (buDa + Ric + tavya .) jYApitavyam । yaTA । boDitavyo'yaM pUrvvapakzaH । iti SANkaraBAzyam ॥

m: बोधि—वृक्ष m. = -तरु, L.
बोध्य mfn. to be known or understood, to be regarded or recognized as (nom.), Vedāntas.; BhP.; Sāh. &c.
to be made known, Vedāntas.
to be enlightened or instructed, Kathās.
बोध्य m. N. of a Ṛṣi, MBh.
a: बोध्य, बोद्धव्य — a. 1 To be known or understood. --2 Intelligible, perceivable. --3 To be informed, instructed &c.

m: बोध्य्-अङ्ग n. a requisite for attaining perfect knowledge, Lalit. (7 in number, Divyāv.; Dharmas. 49)
बोध्य्-अङ्ग—वती f. a partic. Samādhi, L.
बोध्य—गीता f. N. of MBh. xii, 178.

s: tri, (buDyate yaH । buD + tfc .) boDakarttA । yaTA, -- “bodDAro matsaragrastAH praBavaH smayadUzitAH । ajYAnopahatAScAnye jIrRamaNge suBAzitam ॥” iti BarttfhariH ॥

m: बोद्धव्य mfn. (√ बुध्) to be attended to or noticed, MBh.; Kathās.
to be known or perceived or observed or recognized, perceptible, intelligible, Up.; MBh. &c.
to be enlightened or admonished or instructed or informed, one who is informed, Pañcat.; Sāh.
to be awakened or aroused, MW.
बोद्धव्य n. (impers.) it is to be watched or be awaked, Pañcat. (v.l. प्र-ब्˚).
बोद्धव्य बोद्धृ, बोध, बौद्ध &c. See p. 734, col. 2.
बोद्धृ m. one who perceives or comprehends, Sāh.
one who knows or is versed in (loc. or comp.), ChUp.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c. (-त्व n., Kap.)
बोद्धृ—त्व n., Kap.
बोहित्थ m. n. a boat, ship, L. (cf. वहित्र).
बोकण m. or n. (?) N. of a place, Cat.
बोकडी f. Argyreia Speciosa or Argentea, L.
बोक्काण m. a horse's nose-bag (which contains his food), L.

k.v: गैरेयमर्थ्यं गिरिजमश्मजं च शिलाजतु। वोलगन्धरसप्राणपिण्डगोपरसाः समाः॥

m: बोल्लक m. (बहु-ब्˚) a great talker, Divyāv. (cf. Hind. bolnā, to speak).
बोपण्ण-भट्टीय n. N. of wk. (cf. बापण्ण).
बोपदेव See वोपदेव.
बोरसिद्धि f. N. of a place, Cat.
